FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Promptok.
FAQ.a1: Promptok is an AI-powered platform that generates complete TikTok-ready videos from simple text prompts. You choose a theme, write what you want, and AI creates a video with generated scenes, voiceover narration, and captions.
FAQ.q2: How does the AI video generation work?
FAQ.a2: Our pipeline uses multiple AI models: GPT-4o breaks your script into scenes, FLUX generates visuals for each scene, Hailuo animates them into video clips, and ElevenLabs creates the voiceover. Everything is assembled into a final 9:16 vertical video.
FAQ.q3: How long does it take to generate a video?
FAQ.a3: Most videos are generated in 3-5 minutes depending on length and complexity. You'll see real-time progress updates as each stage completes.
FAQ.q4: What video format do I get?
FAQ.a4: Videos are generated in 9:16 vertical format (1080x1920) — optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. You get an MP4 file ready to upload directly.
FAQ.q5: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
FAQ.a5: Yes, you can cancel anytime from your dashboard. You'll keep access until the end of your billing period. No questions asked.
FAQ.q6: Do I own the videos I create?
FAQ.a6: Yes, you have full commercial rights to all videos generated on Promptok. Use them on any platform for any purpose.
